query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `entourage_rules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `rule_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `rule_type` enum('entourage','potentiation','modulation','stabilization','enhancement','contrast') NOT NULL,
  `primary_molecules` json,
  `secondary_molecules` json,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `mechanism` text,
  `olfactive_result` text,
  `applicable_to` json,
  `scientific_basis` text,
  `references` json,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `entourage_rules_type_idx` (`rule_type`)
);
